scope: Evidence-backed Windows API sequences. Matches are observed trace candidates, not qualified execution coverage.

rules.name: OS Credential Dumping: Security Account Manager
rules.rationale: MITRE describes saving both HKLM\SAM and HKLM\SYSTEM for offline credential extraction.

rules.name: Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
rules.rationale: MITRE describes authenticated access to C$ or ADMIN$ and remote file copy. Both calls must name the same host.

rules.name: Permission Groups Discovery: Local Groups
rules.rationale: MITRE defines discovery of local groups and their memberships; require successful local NetAPI group enumeration followed by member retrieval.

rules.name: Remote System Discovery
rules.rationale: MITRE describes listing other network systems; a successful RESOURCE_GLOBALNET WNetOpenEnum followed by WNetEnumResource observes network resource discovery.
